task: W4.2 — THE DECISION EXPERIMENT: coverage-spread retrieval over the W4.1-fixed store
question_subset: 83 all-wrong temporal-before/after questions from the W3.3 ceiling analysis (recomputed 1:1 with w33_ceiling.py: 86 temporal-beforeafter all-wrong = 83 model-capability + 3 store-coverage; the 83 model-capability ones are used; temporal83_ids.json). Subset anno over 2 videos; window ends non-decreasing per video so the store state at each question is identical to the full run (encode content depends only on [0, end)).
store: SAME store config as W4.1 arm (writetime, tax0.5, debias, QUANT=0, NOPASS2, position-free, rank-fetch); encode once per arm run; only retrieval allocation differs; 64-slot budget identical

arms.A0_topk: DECAF_B_POLICY=default (stock relevance order) — answered by the W4.1 full run, 83-question subset (NO extra GPU arm)
arms.A1_uniform: 64 equal temporal bins over [0, store frontier); best-scoring unit per bin (1 slot per unit)
arms.A2_hybrid: 32 slots top-k by similarity + 32 slots uniform spread over bins
arms.A3_stratified: 64 bins; slots apportioned proportional to softmax(bin max similarity); top units per bin up to allocation

load_bearing_constraint: spread bins span ONLY the streamed history [0, frontier) with frontier derived from store segment token_starts; the gold window [start,end] is NOT an input to plan(); asserted in decaf_b._spread_plan (gold_window_used=False logged per question). Spreading over the gold window would be oracle information and voids the experiment.

stats_predeclared.primary: hybrid vs top-k, paired McNemar (exact binomial, two-sided) on the 83 occurrence-indexed questions
stats_predeclared.multiplicity: Holm correction across all 3 arm comparisons
stats_predeclared.mde_statement: PRE-DECLARED before any number exists. n=83, observed base accuracy on these questions ~14%. Exact binomial McNemar at two-sided alpha=0.05 reaches 80% power only when the discordant-pair imbalance |b-c| >= ~13-17 for the expected d=20-30 discordant pairs (computed exactly from the binomial: d=20 -> min |b-c|=13 -> MDE 15.7 pts; d=25 -> 15 -> 18.1 pts; d=30 -> 17 -> 20.5 pts). The test can only detect very large effects (~16-21 accuracy points); anything smaller is underpowered and will be reported as such regardless of outcome. For reference, a +10-pt lift over 14% base yields ~26 expected discordant pairs, at the edge of detectability.
stats_predeclared.decision_mapping: coverage up AND hybrid acc +>=3pts -> diagnosis actionable, Phase-4 redirection justified; coverage up but acc flat -> genuinely model capability, direction closed, diagnosis paper stronger; coverage flat -> allocator bug, not a finding

coverage_definition: same as W3.3: committed frame blocks (2 s each at 0.5 fps; global frame = seg_id*4 + frame) intersect [start,end], plus the local-cache addressable window (stream frontier minus last n_local=15000 tokens = 152 s), divided by window length; min(,1)
